scope: Two optional Ben Arous neighborhood polygons contained within larger same-named official imadas
method: Compare current app feature areas and containment; search each public place on separate existing Android emulators in Google Maps; inspect result title, category context, and displayed dotted place outline. No Google vector or raster content is copied into the app.

rows.name: حي الهضاب
rows.mapsVisibleResult: Cité El Hidhab / حي الهضاب, Fouchana, Tunisia
rows.mapsOutlineObserved: Dotted place boundary surrounds a smaller urban neighborhood; it is not a residence or single building result.
rows.decision: Retain as a separate neighborhood in the picker and GPS catalog. One-way containment in the larger official imada does not make this a duplicate.

limits: The Google screenshots confirm public place identity and show a displayed outline. This review does not extract the Google outline coordinates or quantify agreement with the installed OSM polygons. The official imada boundaries also remain provisional where sourced from OSM.
